description: Per-UNSPSC-code policy record consumed by the commodity_process_orchestrator Pregel cell (per ADR-2605231500). Declares what authorization gates fire when an AAT-bound agent at `did:web:c{unspscCode}.etzhayyim.com` initiates a commodity flow. Sparse — most of the 18,346 UNSPSC codes will never need an explicit manifest; the orchestrator uses safe defaults (default purpose `donation-in-kind`, council escalation threshold 0 = always escalate) when no manifest exists. Manifests are authored by Council Stewards (or the Council Lv6+ supermajority for force-sensitive / eros-gore-tagged codes).

unspscCode.description: UNSPSC commodity code (8 digits, leading zeros preserved). Used verbatim as the AT-record rkey for idempotent re-seeding.

bpmnProcessDef.description: Optional AT URI of the BPMN process_def this commodity follows (via Kyber projector per ADR-2605180600 §F). When present, the agent's LangGraph workflow fires BPMN signal `Signal:esign:{purpose}` at the appropriate gate.

defaultPurpose.description: Default `com.etzhayyim.esign.envelope.purpose` for envelopes emitted on flows under this code. MUST be a Charter-aligned commodity purpose.

forceSensitive.description: When true, the charter-compliance gate requires ForceAuthorization.preAttest() to pass (per ADR-2605192315). Applies to dual-use codes: weapons, cryptographic equipment, bio precursors, controlled chemicals.

erosGoreCategory.description: Optional category requiring Council ruling proxy per ADR-2605192400. Empty when not applicable (the vast majority of UNSPSC codes).

councilEscalationThreshold.description: Per-envelope value/count at which the envelope requires Council Lv6+ ≥3 multisig (replacing requester-only signing). 0 = always escalate (i.e., this code is never agent-driven). Phase 1 interpretation: item count. Phase 2 interpretation: USDC-equivalent (6 decimals).

auditWitnessRequired.description: When true, the yobel `audit_witness` cell is invoked for envelopes under this code (3-party witness pattern). Default false.

customsRequired.description: When true, the envelope MUST carry a `customsRef` field referencing the customs declaration record. Required for codes describing physical goods that cross national borders.

chartersAttestationRef.description: Optional AT URI of the most recent `com.etzhayyim.charters.attest` (or equivalent) covering this code. Snapshotted into the envelope at creation time so Council attestation drift is provable.

description.description: Optional free-text description of this code's commodity scope, why the manifest exists, and any operational notes for the agent.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the manifest publication.
